description: Event Description QBlueprint is a 4-day innovation challenge focused on quantum computing, quantum hardware, physics, electronics, and related engineering applications. Participants will submit their solutions for evaluation by the organizing team. The top-performing teams will advance to the final presentation round, where their projects will be evaluated and the winners will be selected. Eligibility Open to undergraduate and postgraduate students from all disciplines and institutions. Individual participation and team participation are both allowed. Inter-college teams are allowed. Inter-specialization/inter-department teams are allowed. Rules All submissions must be original work. Plagiarism or unfair practices will result in disqualification. Teams must adhere to all deadlines and submission guidelines. The organizers reserve the right to modify the schedule if required. The decision of the organizers and judges will be final and binding.The use of AI is allowed. Submission Requirements Project report/PPT explaining the solution. Supporting files, simulations, code, designs, or prototypes (if applicable). A short demonstration video may be required. All necessary details will be provided with the problem statement. raw.details:
Event Description

QBlueprint is a 4-day innovation challenge focused on quantum computing, quantum hardware, physics, electronics, and related engineering applications. Participants will submit their solutions for evaluation by the organizing team. The top-performing teams will advance to the final presentation round, where their projects will be evaluated and the winners will be selected.

Eligibility

  • Open to undergraduate and postgraduate students from all disciplines and institutions.
  • Individual participation and team participation are both allowed.
  • Inter-college teams are allowed.
  • Inter-specialization/inter-department teams are allowed.

Rules

  • All submissions must be original work.
  • Plagiarism or unfair practices will result in disqualification.
  • Teams must adhere to all deadlines and submission guidelines.
  • The organizers reserve the right to modify the schedule if required.
  • The decision of the organizers and judges will be final and binding.The use of AI is allowed.

Submission Requirements

  • Project report/PPT explaining the solution.
  • Supporting files, simulations, code, designs, or prototypes (if applicable).
  • A short demonstration video may be required.
  • All necessary details will be provided with the problem statement.

Timeline of Events

  • Problem Statement Release: 6 October 2026, 10:00 AM
  • Submission Deadline: 10 October 2026, 10:00 AM

Please join the whatsapp group for all formal information regarding the hackathon GroupLink
